claim: RiskManager's daily-loss cap attributes realized PnL to the UTC day a trade OPENED (trades.created_at), so a loss realized today on a position opened on an earlier day is invisible to today's DAILY_LOSS_CAP gate and sizing budget.
evidence: src/units/accounts/risk.py:465 (_recompute_daily_pnl_from_db: `... AND substr(created_at,1,10)=?`), docstring risk.py:449-453 claims positions 'open and close within the same UTC day in the overwhelming majority of cases'. PLANTED: PYTHONPATH=. python3 scratchpad/plant_risk.py (temp journal: one trade created yesterday, closed today, pnl=-6000; equity 50000; daily_loss_pct 0.05) -> `CASE1 realized today by close date = -6000; cap = 2500.0 | rm.daily_pnl = 0.0 | evaluate = (True, None) | is_daily_cap_exhausted = False`. LIVE: scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh 'journal?table=trades&limit=2000' (served 1000 rows, ids 5226-6225, 2026-08-29..2026-09-27) -> closed live rows with pnl: 603; closed_at on a different UTC day than created_at: 145 (24%); of those losses: 88 summing -90656.70 (ib_paper 3/-56010.00, bybit_1 46/-19737.89, bybit_portfolio 11/-9999.68, alpaca_portfolio 11/-4252.19, alpaca_paper 7/-622.71, bybit_2 10/-34.22). Largest per-account-day gaps (pnl attributed by open-day vs by close-day): ib_paper 2026-09-14 0.00 vs -34940.00; ib_paper 2026-09-01 0.00 vs -21070.00; bybit_portfolio 2026-09-25 0.00 vs -2200.44. trades.closed_at exists and was non-null on 603/603 of these rows.
expected: The daily realized-loss budget counts every loss REALIZED today (closed_at in today UTC), per the module docstring's 'daily_pnl: USD PnL since the last reset'.
actual: Only losses on trades OPENED today count; 24% of closes (n=145/603) are cross-day and their PnL never reaches any day's cap. The intraday-drawdown gate (equity-based, same 5% on most accounts) is the only backstop.
population: live journal, last 1000 trades (ids 5226-6225), 603 closed with pnl, all accounts; planted case n=1
detector: Unit test: closed-today/opened-yesterday loss must count toward daily_pnl (fails today, per the planted case). None exists: tests/test_daily_risk_state_persistence.py seeds created_at=today only.
proposed_fix: Change the predicate to substr(COALESCE(closed_at, created_at),1,10)=? (closed_at is populated on 603/603 live closes) and add the planted test; Tier-3 because it tightens a risk cap.

claim: The monitor's dry_run short-circuit on close / partial-close / modify / fill-capture can never fire: _build_account_client builds cfg['mode'] from getattr(acc, 'mode', 'live'), and TradingAccount has no .mode attribute (the resolved state is acc.dry_run), so every account reads 'live'.
evidence: src/runtime/order_monitor.py:1722 (`"mode": getattr(acc, "mode", "live") or "live"`); gates at order_monitor.py:1804, 1938, 1999, 2078 (`if (cfg or {}).get("mode") == "dry_run"`). src/units/accounts/__init__.py sets acc.dry_run, never .mode (grep 'self\.mode|\.mode =' in account.py/__init__.py -> no match). RUN: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from src.units.accounts import load_accounts; ...getattr(a,'mode','live')..." -> all 11 accounts `hasattr(mode)= False`, including `ib_live ... dry_run= True -> live` and `oanda_practice ... dry_run= True -> live`. LIVE: 0 open trades rows on ib_live/oanda_practice among the last 1000 (ib_live roster is empty). Tests miss it: tests/test_order_monitor_build_account_client.py uses MagicMock accounts (MagicMock fabricates .mode); tests/test_s030_pr4_exchange_modify_close.py patches _build_account_client with a hand-built cfg.
expected: A mode: dry_run account never receives a close/modify order from the monitor (its declared contract, and accounts.yaml's 'real money held safe; no socket opened, no orders placed' for ib_live).
actual: For any open trade row on a dry_run account the monitor builds a real client and sends reduce-only closes and SL/TP modifies. Inert today because no dry_run account holds a row; it becomes live when a live account holding positions is demoted to dry_run (the Gate-2 demotion shape).
population: 11 accounts in config/accounts.yaml (2 dry_run); 4 gate sites; live trades rows n=1000 (0 affected today)
detector: A test building the cfg from a REAL TradingAccount loaded from a mode: dry_run YAML and asserting the four senders return skipped='dry_run' with the client untouched.
proposed_fix: 'mode': 'dry_run' if getattr(acc, 'dry_run', False) else 'live' in _build_account_client (the reconcile loader at ~order_monitor.py:2865 already reads the raw YAML mode correctly).
disposition: filed (docs/claude/work/pipeline PI-20260927-KRAKE1TG-0002); found by a lane reader sub-agent, re-verified by the lane

claim: IBClient.close() places the flattening market order even when its Step-1 pre-cancel could not read the open-order book, because _open_trades collapses an openTrades() exception into [] and _locked_close discards the cancel result.
evidence: src/units/accounts/ib_client.py:4731-4735 (_open_trades: except -> return []); ib_client.py:2642 (`self._cancel_resting_orders_for_symbol(ib, sym)`, return value unused) then Step 2 MarketOrder; the file's own note at ib_client.py:3355-3359 names the collapse. RUN (lane): FakeIB.openTrades raises -> `{'verify_state': 'not_attempted', 'still_resting': [], 'confirmed_gone': [], 'account_wide_seen': None, 'seen': 0, 'cancelled': 0, 'failed': 0}`, no exception, no warning.
expected: Per close()'s docstring: resting protection is cancelled BEFORE the opposing order, so the close is 'naked-order-free'; an unreadable book must not read as 'nothing rests'.
actual: On a transient Gateway read failure the bracket is left resting over a flat book; a later fill opens a reverse position (the BL-20260624-MHG-FLIP / CA-A01-001 outcome).
population: 2 order-path callers (_locked_close :2642, _locked_cancel_resting_protection :3627); historical occurrence not searched
detector: Test: raising openTrades() -> close() places no MarketOrder and returns a defer; extend test_read_failure_is_not_evidence_of_no_strays to the two cancel helpers.
proposed_fix: Read ib.openTrades() directly in _cancel_resting_orders_for_symbol/_cancel_oca_group_for_symbol, return verify_state='unreadable', and defer the flatten on it.
disposition: filed (docs/claude/work/pipeline PI-20260927-KRAKE1TG-0003); found by a lane reader sub-agent, re-verified by the lane

claim: RiskManager's gross-exposure measurement (observe_exposure / _open_gross_notional_from_db) and the headroom clamp compute notional as position_size x entry_price with no contract multiplier, understating futures notional by the contract value (MES 5x, MGC 10x, MHG 2500x).
evidence: src/units/accounts/risk.py:500-507 (SUM(ABS(position_size*entry_price))), risk.py:1263 (max_qty_by_exposure = headroom / package.entry). config/instruments.yaml MHG contract_value_usd: 2500.0. PLANTED: plant_risk.py CASE2 (open MHG 22 contracts @4.5, ceiling 1.0x) -> `journal notional = 99.0 true notional = 247500.0 multiple = 0.00198 verdict = clamp`. grep -n max_gross_exposure_pct config/*.yaml -> no matches (no ceiling declared anywhere today).
expected: Notional = qty x price x contract_value_usd_for(symbol), the same cvu position_size already uses for risk.
actual: Futures exposure reads 2500x low for MHG; a declared ceiling would never bind on ib_paper/ib_live, and RiskManager.report()['exposure'] (served to operator surfaces) under-reports futures exposure today.
population: code path over all futures symbols in config/instruments.yaml (MES, MGC, MHG); planted n=1
blast_radius: observability (money-at-risk once a ceiling is declared on a futures account)
detector: Unit test: observe_exposure on a planted MHG open row equals qty*price*2500.
proposed_fix: Multiply by contract_value_usd_for(symbol) in both SUM queries (do it in Python per row) and divide headroom by entry*cvu.

claim: _submit_order's alpaca, oanda and IB branches still return a fabricated uuid4().hex trade id when the venue envelope reports success without an orderId (or is empty), the exact defect BL-20260830 removed from the Bybit branch.
evidence: src/units/accounts/execute.py:1263, 1303, 1355 (`return str(order_id or uuid.uuid4().hex)`), contrast execute.py:1643-1650 (Bybit raises 'refusing to fabricate a trade id'). PLANTED: fake AlpacaClient.place -> {'retCode':0,'result':{'orderId':''}} gives `alpaca id-less accept -> a3aa5bfb...`; place -> {} gives `alpaca empty envelope -> 33228d08...`; OandaClient.place id-less -> `88ae19e4...`. oanda_client.py place returns orderId str(fill.get('id') or create.get('id') or '') so '' is a reachable success. LIVE: 0 of 1000 trades carry a 32-hex broker_order_id (not observed yet).
expected: Same contract as the Bybit branch: an accept with no order id raises and journals exchange_rejected, never a phantom open row.
actual: A phantom open trade row keyed to an invented id would be journaled on alpaca_live (real money), alpaca_paper/portfolio, oanda and IB.
population: 4 broker branches of _submit_order; 3 affected; live rows n=1000, 0 occurrences
blast_radius: accounting (phantom open row; the monitor then manages a position the venue never opened)
detector: Parametrised test over exchange in (alpaca, oanda, ib) asserting RuntimeError on {'retCode':0,'result':{}}; mirrors the Bybit test.
proposed_fix: Replace the three `order_id or uuid4().hex` returns with the Bybit branch's raise.

claim: place_options_expression fetches option snapshots for the whole underlying chain with only limit=200 and no expiry/strike/type filter or pagination, so the 21-60 DTE contracts it selected are usually unquoted and every live expression is refused 'fewer_than_two_quotable_strikes'.
evidence: src/units/accounts/options_overlay.py:258 (`snap_env = data_client.snapshots(underlying, limit=200)`) vs :246-255 (contracts filtered to DTE<=60, +-12% strikes, type); alpaca_options_data.py:156 params = {feed, limit} only; options_selector.py:137-142 requires >=2 quoted legs in the chosen expiry. LIVE: alpaca_options_paper rows in the last 1000 trades: 14, all status=rejected; 11 are dry_run_no_order_placed (slv_trend_1h, execution: shadow) and ALL 3 live-leg attempts (5876 slv_pullback_1d, 5351 gdx_pullback_1d, 5269 slv_pullback_1d) carry reason 'options_expression:no_selection:fewer_than_two_quotable_strikes'. Which 200 contracts the venue returns first was NOT verified against Alpaca (no creds in this sandbox) — the mechanism is PLAUSIBLE, the 3/3 refusal is MEASURED.
expected: Snapshots requested for exactly the contract set selected in step 1 (by symbols= list or the same expiration/strike/type filters, paginated).
actual: 0 of 3 live options expressions placed in the window; the declared Slice-3b capability has never placed a spread in this population.
population: alpaca_options_paper trades rows 2026-08-29..2026-09-27, n=14 (3 live-leg attempts)
blast_radius: observability (paper account; a stranded capability reading as wired)
detector: Test with a fake data client whose snapshots honour limit and return the nearest expiry first; assert the selected-expiry legs are quoted. Plus a soak count of options_expression refusal reasons.
proposed_fix: Pass the step-1 contract symbols (or expiration_date_gte/lte, type, strike bounds) to snapshots and follow page_token.

claim: PropRiskManager's mission counters and base daily-loss/drawdown caps cannot move at runtime for breakout_1: record_trade_result has zero callers in src/, and breakout_1 writes no trades rows for the base RiskManager's journal rebuild to read.
evidence: grep -rn 'record_trade_result\|\.update_equity(' src --include=*.py | grep -v 'def ' -> only docstrings/comments and prop_risk.py:334 (super() call inside the method itself). prop_risk.py:23-37 docstring: 'State persistence (two mechanisms, both live ...)'; 'record_trade_result writes the counters back atomically'. grep write_prop_state src -> only prop_state_io.py (definition) and prop_risk.py. LIVE: 0 breakout_1 rows among the last 1000 trades (execute.py:237-240 by design writes none). config/accounts.yaml breakout_1: type prop, mode live, account_state evaluation, target_profit_pct 0.1. src/units/ui/processor.py:207 renders `status.get('cumulative_pnl_pct') or 0.0`, so the never-updated counter reads as 0% progress.
expected: Mission progress and the prop daily-loss cap reflect realized prop PnL, as the docstring says.
actual: cumulative_pnl_pct/active_days only ever hold the YAML/prop_state.json seed; SKIP_MISSION_MET cannot fire from live progress and DAILY_LOSS_CAP sees daily_pnl=0. (src/prop/prop_risk_gate.py is a separate ticket-risk grader, outside this lane's scope, not checked here.)
population: src/ call sites (grep, n=0 runtime callers); live trades rows n=1000
blast_radius: money-at-risk (prop evaluation account; manual ticket bridge keeps a human in the loop)
detector: A test that closes a prop trade through the real close path and asserts PropRiskManager.cumulative_pnl_pct changed; a guard that fails when a public RiskManager state mutator has no src caller.
proposed_fix: Feed prop realized PnL (prop_reconcile's figure) into PropRiskManager.record_trade_result, or retire the counters and point the docstring and UI at prop_risk_gate; render the unmeasured counter as null.

claim: dup_key_check.find_duplicate_keys never forwards api_secret_env to resolve_credentials, so every account with a custom secret env name (alpaca_portfolio, alpaca_live, alpaca_options_paper) resolves to None and is silently skipped; a key shared between real-money alpaca_live and another account is never reported.
evidence: src/units/accounts/dup_key_check.py:42-45 (dict has only api_key_env + exchange); clients.py:53-57 _derive_secret_env falls back to api_key_env.replace('_API_KEY','_API_SECRET') -> 'ALPACA_API_SECRET_ID_LIVE' (actual: ALPACA_API_SECRET_KEY_LIVE, accounts.yaml:1283). PLANTED: env ALPACA_API_KEY_ID_LIVE=ALPACA_API_KEY_ID_OPTIONS='SAMEKEY' with both secrets set -> `find_duplicate_keys(load_accounts())` returns `[]`. alpaca_paper has api_key_env '' and is skipped too. Caller: src/main.py:936-937 warn_on_duplicate_keys at startup. tests/test_dup_key_check.py never sets api_secret_env.
expected: Every account with resolvable credentials participates in the duplicate-key comparison.
actual: All 4 Alpaca accounts are excluded, so the BUG-033 safety net covers only Bybit.
population: 11 accounts; 4 alpaca excluded (3 by the secret-env bug, 1 by empty api_key_env)
blast_radius: money-at-risk (detector gap for wrong-account routing on a real-money account; no mis-route observed)
detector: Test: two accounts with custom api_secret_env sharing a key must be reported.
proposed_fix: Pass api_secret_env=getattr(acc,'api_secret_env',None) (and resolve the key directly from api_key_env; a duplicate KEY does not need the secret).
disposition: filed (jsonl); found by a lane reader sub-agent, re-verified by the lane

claim: IB cancel/read helpers on the protection path (_cancel_resting_orders_for_symbol, _cancel_oca_group_for_symbol, has_protective_orders, protection_coverage, list_open_orders) match on contract.symbol only and never filter by self.account, unlike positions(), which does.
evidence: grep of ib_client.py:3494-3600 finds no `self.account` reference in _cancel_resting_orders_for_symbol; positions() filters `str(it_acct) != str(self.account)`. Sub-agent mock: two MES trades, order.account DU111111 (own) and DU222222 -> cancelOrder called for both ids [1, 2]. config/accounts.yaml puts ib_paper and ib_live on separate Gateways today.
expected: A cancel for one account never touches another account's orders on a shared login.
actual: Dormant: it would cancel a sibling account's protection if two IB accounts ever share a Gateway login.
population: 5 helpers; 2 IB accounts on separate gateways (0 exposure today)
detector: Test with two-account openTrades asserting only own-account orders are cancelled.
proposed_fix: Apply the positions() account filter to order.account in every helper.
disposition: filed (jsonl); found by a lane reader sub-agent; the lane confirmed the missing filter by reading, not by a live run

claim: AlpacaClient.modify_protective returns a bare retCode 1 when one leg PATCH succeeds and the other fails, dropping the `patched` list, so order_monitor never syncs trades.stop_loss/take_profit_1 for the leg that did change at the venue.
evidence: src/units/accounts/alpaca_client.py:1753-1781 (`if errors: return {'retCode': 1, 'retMsg': ...}` with no patched ids); consumer src/runtime/order_monitor.py:1444-1512 syncs DB fields only for legs marked applied. Sub-agent mock: stop PATCH 0, limit PATCH 422 -> `{'retCode': 1, 'retMsg': "leg replace failed for orders ['limit1']"}`.
expected: The return names which legs landed, so the journal matches the venue.
actual: The journal keeps the old stop while the new stop is live at the broker, until the other leg succeeds.
detector: Test: mixed PATCH results -> result carries patched ids and order_monitor syncs that leg.
proposed_fix: Return {'retCode': 1, 'result': {'patched': [...], 'failed': [...]}} and sync the patched legs.
disposition: filed (jsonl); found by a lane reader sub-agent; the lane confirmed the code shape by reading

claim: Two AlpacaClient.close() retCode-2 'defer' messages ('... is DEFERRED rather than falling back ...', '... DEFERRED to the regular session ...') do not contain any substring order_monitor matches as a defer, so they are counted as real close failures and can raise the 'won't flatten' alarm.
evidence: alpaca_client.py:1021-1025 and :1188-1194 (messages); order_monitor.py:1081-1083 (`'exit deferred' in s or 'deferring' in s or 'market closed' in s`). RUN (lane): both real messages -> `False False`. The monitor branches on message text, not on retCode 2.
expected: retCode 2 is a quiet defer, per both docstrings and order_monitor.py:1072-1080.
actual: ERROR log, _CLOSE_FAIL_STREAK increments, and past the threshold enqueue_close_failure fires on a deliberately safe no-op.
detector: Test enumerating every retCode-2 return in AlpacaClient.close paths through the monitor's classifier; better, carry a structured 'deferred' flag instead of matching text.
proposed_fix: Have close_open_position pass retCode through and branch on retCode == 2 in order_monitor.
disposition: filed (jsonl); found by a lane reader sub-agent, re-verified by the lane

claim: _open_notional_for_symbol filters COALESCE(is_backtest, 1) = 0 while _open_gross_notional_from_db filters COALESCE(is_backtest, 0) = 0, contradicting the docstring that says the two 'deliberately mirror' each other so total - own is comparable.
evidence: src/units/accounts/risk.py:562 vs risk.py:507; docstring risk.py:546-550. LIVE: is_backtest NULL on 0 of 1000 trades rows (0 open), so no current effect.
actual: A NULL is_backtest open row counts in the total but not in 'own', inflating the pledged-margin estimate for other symbols (conservative direction).
detector: Test inserting an open row with is_backtest NULL and asserting total - own == 0 for that symbol.

claim: _fetch_balance's docstring promises direction-aware spot balances (base coin for shorts, USDT for longs) but the code ignores direction and symbol and sums every coin's usdValue; a read failure returns 0.0, indistinguishable from an empty account.
evidence: src/units/accounts/execute.py:780-845 (direction/symbol never read; `except Exception ... defaulting to 0` then `return 0.0`). No bybit account has market_type spot in config/accounts.yaml (checked: []), so the spot branch is unreachable today; callers: execute.py:356 and pairs_executor.py:1168 (which maps 0 to None).
expected: Docstring matches code; unreadable balance returns None.
actual: Dead promise; collapsed 'could not read' -> 0.0 (execute_pkg then raises 'qty=0 ... under-funded').
detector: None needed beyond removing the claim; collapsed-state: add to scripts/ci/check_collapsed_states.py CONTRACTS if kept.
proposed_fix: Delete the spot direction paragraph; return None on failure and let execute_pkg raise 'balance unreadable'.

claim: On an options-expressing account a shadow/dry leg exits execute_pkg before the options branch, so its journal row records the EQUITY-sized share qty (e.g. 1547 SLV shares) as sized qty for an account that would only ever place a few contracts.
evidence: execute.py:369-419 (is_dry returns before :455-497); options_overlay.py is_dry branch (select+size without placing) is therefore unreachable from execute_pkg. LIVE: alpaca_options_paper shadow rows 6102/6099/6073/... position_size 1547.0/1540.0/1481.0 SLV at ~58-60 (~$90k notional) with reason dry_run_no_order_placed.
expected: A shadow leg on an options account records the vertical it would have placed (contracts, debit), which the overlay can already compute without placing.
actual: Shadow soak rows on alpaca_options_paper carry a size and instrument the account never trades, so the Stage-1 soak cannot measure the options expression at all.
detector: Test: execute_pkg dry on an options account journals notes.options with contracts, not the share qty.
proposed_fix: Route options accounts to place_options_expression(is_dry=True) before the generic dry return and journal its structure.
